description: A REAL 61-byte DNS response for example.com A, captured live off the wire from 1.1.1.1 (2026-06-13). Header id 0x1234, flags 0x8180 (QR 1 response, RD 1, RA 1, RCODE 0 NOERROR), QDCOUNT 1, ANCOUNT 2. The question echoes example.com A IN, then two Answer A records using RFC 1035 §4.1.4 name compression (the 0xc00c pointer back to the QNAME at offset 12), TTL 40s, RDATA 104.20.23.154 and 172.66.147.243.

provenance.captured_with: python3 UDP socket: sent the canonical example.com A query to 1.1.1.1:53 and recorded the raw 61-byte response
provenance.verified_against: the response header parses to QR=1 AA=0 RD=1 RA=1 RCODE=0 (NOERROR), ANCOUNT=2; the two A records' RDATA (104.20.23.154, 172.66.147.243) are example.com's real Cloudflare-fronted addresses at capture time. The 0xc00c compression pointer (RFC 1035 §4.1.4) points to the QNAME at offset 12.
provenance.honesty_note: Real bytes off the wire. The two A records, TTL, and the compression pointer are the live response; the dissector's decode is the oracle, cross-checked against the manual byte read.
